title: No file
logline: The divider that isn't a page: the book prints a blank sheet with one line. Recorded here so the run has it.

panels.composition: A blank page. Centered, small, in the book's type, not the strip's: 'January 2021 — no file.' Nothing else. (In the digital edition this is an interlude card.)
panels.caption: January 2021 — no file.

image.prompt: a completely blank cream page with one small line of typeset text centered, nothing else
image.notes: Tier C. Not art. Included as a script so the sequence is complete.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Box 20 ends. The aggregator's hiatus banner goes up and is still up in 2027.
